description: Identify the right tool for a process step. Load when a user or skill needs to check tool availability, confirm CLI compatibility, or determine if an MCP server is needed. Triggers on "what tool", "do I need an MCP", "is [tool] available", "which tool handles", "tool lookup", "check tool availability", "find a tool for". Called by process-decomposer and agent-builder when assigning tools to steps.
